query:
SELECT 
    table_name,
    table_rows,
    ROUND(data_length / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS data_mb,
    ROUND(index_length / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS index_mb
FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE table_schema = DATABASE()
AND table_name IN ('dashboard_items', 'software_items', 'systems_items', 'decisions', 'upcoming_reviews', 'milestones')
ORDER BY table_name;
